content.title: Muslims Day v6.3.0: A Little Closer to Your Ibadah!
content.subtitle: What’s New in the Latest Update?
content.body:
Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullahi wa Barakatuhu.

Dear brothers and sisters in Deen, To make your everyday worship experience easier and more reliable, Muslims Day v6.3.0 brings new Features and important Improvements. Keeping your needs in mind, this Update is designed to make your journey of worship smoother and more convenient. Let’s see what has changed in this new version.

May Your Moments of Dhikr Become More Vibrant

Dhikr is not merely the repetition of words; it is the heart’s yearning offered to the One we love. To make these quiet moments more meaningful, Tasbeeh has received a new experience:

  • A Completely New Tasbeeh Experience: With the new Tasbeeh design, you can choose and use your preferred Dhikr more easily.

  • Create Dhikr Your Way: You can now create and save your own Custom Dhikr. You can also view your Tasbeeh History.

  • Durood and Istighfar Reminder: Even when your phone is on silent, reminders for Durood and Istighfar will play with audio. You can also turn off audio and use only Soft Vibration, so you can maintain your worship habit in any situation.

May Prayer Times Be More Precise

At the end of the day, a believer’s true refuge is the sacred ground of Sujood. So that these moments with our Lord are not clouded by uncertainty, we have focused carefully on accuracy:

  • Instant Location Detection: GPS tracking has been made faster and more precise for Location Setup. You can also manually choose your preferred city when needed.

  • More Accurate Prayer Times: A new Birmingham Prayer Calculation Method has been added for users in Birmingham, UK.

  • Forbidden-Time Salat Reminder: To help prevent accidental prayer during times when prayer should be avoided, we have added the Forbidden-Time Salat Reminder.

Lighter on Your Phone, More Effortless to Use

Your device may have limited space, but your opportunity to stay connected with your Lord should never be limited. That is why the Android App Size has been reduced. Installation will be faster, less storage will be required, and everyday use will be more seamless.

Carefully Removing the Thorns from Your Spiritual Journey

Even a small technical issue can disturb the heart during deep devotion. That is why we have worked carefully to resolve previous technical problems:

  • Fixed crashes when selecting text on older Android devices.

  • Fixed an issue where reminders could incorrectly show minutes as hours.

  • Fixed stacked prayer reminders on Android.

  • Fixed the city search box becoming unresponsive when the screen was locked.

  • Fixed battery-saver-related prompts on Samsung devices.

A Loving Bridge Behind the Technology

Behind every Muslims Day Update is a simple dream: that you never forget Allah, even amid life’s busyness. Perhaps a Reminder will make you pause for a few moments. Perhaps a Dhikr will bring peace back to your busy heart. Perhaps a Prayer Time will help you stand in Sujood at the right moment. These small moments mean so much to us.

Your prayers and love guide us on this journey. Update your Muslims Day (v6.3.0) from the Play Store today; amid worldly restlessness, make your quiet spiritual companion even more personal and dependable.
